calculator.title: How old is your dog?

info.title: The Science
info.description: Traditional formula (7 human years = 1 dog year) is inaccurate. Our calculator uses epigenetic clock research from UC San Diego (2020) which analyzed DNA methylation patterns to determine biological aging.
info.disclaimer: Based on Labrador Retrievers research. Results may vary for different breeds.
info.basedOn: Based on epigenetic clock research by UC San Diego (2020)

share.title: Share result
share.text: My dog is {dogAge} years old — that's {humanAge} in human years! Calculate your dog's age: truedogage.com

cookie.title: Cookie Settings
cookie.description: We use cookies to analyze traffic and improve your experience. By clicking "Accept", you consent to our use of cookies.

formulaModal.title: Where does this formula come from?
formulaModal.intro: Scientists from UC San Diego (2020) studied DNA from 104 Labrador Retrievers and discovered: dogs don't age linearly! They age rapidly early in life, then slow down.
formulaModal.mythBuster: Forget the "multiply by 7" rule — it's a myth.
formulaModal.formulaExplanation: H — human age, D — dog age, ln — natural logarithm
formulaModal.sourcePaperTitle: Quantitative Translation of Dog-to-Human Aging by Conserved Remodeling of the DNA Methylome
